name: A source
title: One line, *and the rows stay*
lede: Rows in memory are gone at every restart. One entry in sources: puts them in SQLite. The boot then refuses until the table exists, and npm run migrate creates it.
fig: The handler asks for its rows as before. Where they live is a line of config.

grows.label: npm run migrate
grows.detail: creates the posts table, read from Post

grows.label: the boot, until you migrate
grows.detail: it names what the database is missing, and the command

try.output:
Fougere boot refused: the database is missing 1 change(s) from the entities:
  posts — no table
  On your machine: fougere migrate --latest --apply
